Workspace and state ownership
|
|-- [O] CanvasWorkspace
|   |-- Creates / subscribes to / disposes CanvasSessions
|   |-- drafts[documentId]: CanvasDraft
|   |   |-- Identity: representationId / name / revisionId
|   |   |-- Save baseline: savedName / savedScene / savedEdges
|   |   |-- Presentation: busy / hidden / viewport / focusBox
|   |   `-- session: CanvasSession
|   |       `-- Retains MappingDocumentController
|   `-- controllers[documentId] indexes those same controllers
|
|-- [O] MappingDocumentController retains editing state
|   |-- MappingGridDocument
|   |   |-- LineGridScene.root: GridBox
|   |   |   |-- diagram instance -> contentId
|   |   |   `-- container -> nested GridBoxes
|   |   |-- LineGridScene.contents[id]: Diagram
|   |   |   |-- ASCII + parsed content structure
|   |   |   `-- source context -> mappings + captured evidence
|   |   `-- edges / jumps / sections
|   |-- MappingCanvasState
|   |   |-- selection.items[]: unified diagram / region membership
|   |   |-- diagramViews: per-diagram folding
|   |   |-- DisplayState: selections, projections, conversations, details
|   |   `-- MappingControls
|   |       |-- activeBoxId / selectionFocusId / activeThreadId
|   |       `-- surfaces[ownerId]: SelectionSurfaceState
|   `-- Retains CanvasEditingContext attachment
|       `-- [O] CanvasHistoryService owns its lifetime
|
`-- [M] Session exposes coordinated stores
    |-- document / presentation / selection
    `-- controls / geometry / status
